description.text: Department of Tourism and Hotel Management Being adapted to the development of modern tourism and hotel management industry, the department of tourism and hotel management has raised many intermediate or senior managerial and technical talented persons with lofty makings, consummation personality, solid foundation of basic skills and exquisite skill. The graduates widely get employed in star-rated hotels, travel agencies, scenic spot units, modern commerce companies and so on. The department positively establishes the professional environment and reduces the disparity between talented persons’ practice are in construction. The department implements the department thought diligently which is to unify “produce, study and grind “.Till now, the institution has established friendly relationship with many domestic and foreign institutions. “Surmount your expectation!” we diligently strive after for it.

duration.text: The Tourism management at Qingdao Hismile College is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
